Lina (product): quick sync — were reviewing the compact version-history row for canaries. two quick questions: should the primary CTA read 'Hold traffic' or 'Pause rollout'? and should we surface 'Create restore point' inline before pausing? figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-history-v2 Arun (design): initial thoughts: 'Hold traffic' reads slightly clearer to non-technical PMs. 'Pause' feels transient; 'Hold' implies stop without revert. still want a clear secondary action for snapshot/restore point. Felix (frontend): keyboard/access notes: if we add shortcuts they should be discoverable from the row (tooltip: "press ? for shortcuts"). prefer inline popover confirm for risky actions (rollback) to avoid context switch. implement undo toast for 8s. Kai (eng-runtime): rollback triggers an async op and may run routing changes across clusters. UX must show op-id and a progress state. also recommend: if a rollback affects >40% traffic, require a checkbox confirmation 'I understand this will change live traffic'. Tess (a11y): SR guidance: Non-destructive: aria-live="polite". Destructive (rollback/revert): use role="alertdialog" + assertive announce. For inline snapshot success toast use role="status". Example SR text suggestion: "Restore point created for v2.3.1. You can roll back to this point." Lina (product): copy candidates to pick from: - Candidate 1: Primary = "Hold traffic"; secondary = "Create restore point"; overflow = "Rollback to previous" - Candidate 2: Primary = "Pause rollout"; secondary = "Snapshot"; overflow = "Rollback (danger)" - Candidate 3: Primary = "Hold + Snapshot"; secondary = "Resume" (combines actions) Arun (design): I like Candidate 1. separates concerns and keeps the danger action tucked in overflow. UI suggestion: small soft label under row, e.g. "Held 60% traffic — restore point saved" (use short form). Felix (frontend): implementation detail: for narrow viewports show text label next to pill (avoid relying on color). popover markup must trap focus and return it to the invoking button. sample snippet: ```
Held at 60% 60% traffic
Rollback to v2.3.1 started 60; op #op-7789
``` Tess (a11y): important: include a visually-hidden text node with the human readable state for SR: "Held 60% 12 restore point created". also avoid "pause" language in alerts to reduce ambiguity. Kai (eng-runtime): we'll emit op-id and estimated ETA in seconds if possible: 'op-7789 (ETA ~90s)'. agree on confirmation checkbox for >40% traffic changes. Lina (product): visual question: heatline to show traffic delta between versions — good idea? Arun (design): heatline is useful but add pattern semantics: gradient + chevrons for direction. fallback icon for color-blind. Felix (frontend): ensure heatline respects contrast ratios and expose aria-label with numeric delta. for very small rows show textual delta like "+15%". Lina (product): quick poll: reply with :+1: for Candidate 1, :heart: for Candidate 2, :thinking_face: other. Arun (design): :+1: Felix (frontend): :+1: Kai (eng-runtime): :heart: (lean Candidate 2 if we need one-click snapshot) Tess (a11y): :+1: (Candidate 1 with sr text) CI-Bot: Restore point snap-20240209-7789 created for v2.3.1 Lina (product): action items: 1) Arun update microcopy + small "held" label 2) Felix wire inline confirm + undo toast + shortcut hints 3) Kai emit op-id + ETA + threshold checkbox 4) Tess provide SR copy bundle. I'll post an updated mock by EOD. Thanks!"
